<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace App\Modules\Events\Services;

use App\Models\User;
use App\Modules\Events\Contracts\Repositories\EventRepositoryInterface;
use App\Modules\Events\Enums\EventState;
use App\Modules\Events\Events\EventStateTransitioned;
use App\Modules\Events\Exceptions\EventStateLocked;
use App\Modules\Events\Exceptions\IllegalStateTransition;
use App\Modules\Events\Models\Event;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\DB;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Event as EventDispatcher;
use Platform\AuditLogging\Contracts\AuditLoggerInterface;
use App\Modules\Events\Support\EventAuditEvents;

/**
 * Epic 2 refactor — state-machine hub extracted from EventService.
 *
 * Move-only: transition() and authorizeEventTransition() are byte-for-byte
 * from EventService L1331–L1474. The only edits inside the moved bodies are
 * mechanical rewrites of $this->X(...) calls onto explicit collaborator fields.
 *
 * Extracted first because publish/forceEnd delegate to transition(), making
 * this the dependency hub for all lifecycle/moderation clusters.
 */
class EventStateMachineService
{
    public function __construct(
        private readonly AuditLoggerInterface $auditLogger,
        private readonly EventRepositoryInterface $events,
        private readonly EventAuthorizationService $authz,
    ) {}

    /**
     * Story 2-3a — central state-transition method.
     *
     * Concurrency contract (R-002):
     *   1. lockForUpdate the event row (events row only — no nested locks).
     *   2. Re-read state inside the lock.
     *   3. Re-check `cancelled_at IS NULL` — cancellation always wins forward transitions (§10 Q2).
     *   4. Same-state? No-op return — supports double-click + scheduler retry idempotency.
     *   5. Validate canTransitionTo; if illegal, emit `event.transition_denied` audit then throw.
     *   6. Write state + audit row in same tx.
     *   7. Dispatch domain event AFTER tx commits (post-commit only).
     *
     * Race-sim coverage (P0 race pairs) is exercised by
     * tests/Feature/Events/EventRaceTest using the EventRaceSimulator fixture.
     */
    public function transition(
        Event $event,
        EventState $next,
        User $actor,
        string $reason = '',
        bool $allowForceEndAuthority = false,
    ): Event
    {
        // R1 BLOCKER #1 — service-layer Gate assertion (Rule 30 + Epic 1 canon).
        // Provider-context system actors are admitted via events.update.global;
        // user-context callers need events.update.team OR a Gate-allowed
        // provider grant. Per-target capabilities (one per
        // EventState value) are deferred — they'd need 7 cap rows per role and
        // add no real safety beyond the wrapper checks (publish/suspend/cancel
        // each layer their own gate). Rationale tracked in story Completion Notes.
        $this->authorizeEventTransition($event, $next, $actor, $allowForceEndAuthority);

        // R2 BLOCKER #2 — separate-tx pattern for denied audit.
        // Outer tx ONLY locks + reads + (on legal edge) writes state + audit.
        // Denied path returns the 'denied' signal WITHOUT touching the audit;
        // the verifier emits the denied audit in its OWN transaction outside
        // the closure (so a logger throw rolls back ONLY the audit savepoint
        // and never masks the IllegalStateTransition that follows).
        // R1 HIGH #4 — drop TeamScope inside the service: the Gate above
        // enforces tenancy explicitly, so falling-through to ModelNotFoundException
        // (404) when a SystemAdmin acts cross-team would be wrong.
        $result = DB::transaction(function () use ($event, $next, $actor, $reason): array {
            $fresh = $this->events->lockEventForServiceWrite($event->getKey());

            // R1 HIGH #3 — cancellation re-check ABOVE same-state.
            // A same-state call on a cancelled event must throw, not silently no-op.
            if ($fresh->cancelled_at !== null) {
                throw EventStateLocked::for($fresh);
            }

            if ($fresh->state === $next) {
                return [$fresh, $fresh->state, 'noop'];
            }

            if (! $fresh->state->canTransitionTo($next)) {
                // Do NOT log here — the closure-throw + DB::transaction would
                // rollback any audit row we wrote AND re-raise the logger's

namespace App\Modules\Events\Enums;

/**
 * Story 2-1 — Canonical event state machine (Phase 1, 8 states, 20 legal edges).
 *
 * Single source of truth: docs/specs/event-states.md (PF-1 Reading A,
 * reconciled 2026-04-25).
 *
 * - DB column: VARCHAR — values match the lowercase string values below.
 * - SUSPENDED is reachable from any non-SUSPENDED state via EventService::suspend().
 * - Reactivation from SUSPENDED uses the audit ledger (see Story 2-6 sketch).
 */
enum EventState: string
{
    case DRAFT = 'draft';
    case PUBLISHED = 'published';
    case PREPARING = 'preparing';
    case READY = 'ready';
    case LIVE = 'live';
    case ENDED = 'ended';
    case FAILED = 'failed';
    case SUSPENDED = 'suspended';

    /**
     * Canonical legal-transition table. Mirrors docs/specs/event-states.md.
     *
     * @return list<self>
     */
    public function transitionsTo(): array
    {
        return match ($this) {
            self::DRAFT => [self::PUBLISHED, self::SUSPENDED, self::FAILED],
            self::PUBLISHED => [self::PREPARING, self::SUSPENDED, self::FAILED],
            self::PREPARING => [self::READY, self::FAILED, self::SUSPENDED],
            self::READY => [self::LIVE, self::FAILED, self::SUSPENDED],
            self::LIVE => [self::ENDED, self::FAILED, self::SUSPENDED, self::READY],
            self::ENDED => [self::FAILED, self::SUSPENDED],
            self::FAILED => [self::PREPARING, self::SUSPENDED],
            self::SUSPENDED => [],
        };
    }

    public function canTransitionTo(self $next): bool
    {
        return in_array($next, $this->transitionsTo(), strict: true);
    }

    /** SUSPENDED is reachable from any non-SUSPENDED state. */
    public function canBeSuspendedFrom(): bool
    {
        return $this !== self::SUSPENDED;
    }

    /** True when the event row's core metadata is read-only. */
    public function isMetadataLocked(): bool
    {
        return $this !== self::DRAFT;
    }

    /**
     * True when the event must reject new registrations.
     * DRAFT blocks because the landing page is private until PUBLISHED.
     */
    public function blocksRegistration(): bool
    {
        return in_array($this, [self::DRAFT, self::ENDED, self::FAILED, self::SUSPENDED], strict: true);
    }

    /**
     * Story 5-14 — True when the event is in a state that supports live
     * streaming operations (control room, go-live, end-event).
     *
     * Single source of truth for the READY|LIVE check previously duplicated
     * across EventActionAvailability, ControlRoomController::isOperable,
     * and StreamingLifecycleService claim methods.
     */
    public function isLiveOperable(): bool
    {
        return $this === self::READY || $this === self::LIVE;
    }

    /**
     * Story 5-14 — True when the event has reached the terminal ENDED state.
     */
    public function isEnded(): bool
    {
        return $this === self::ENDED;
    }

    /** Translation key for UI label. Resolves through __() at render-time. */
    public function label(): string
    {
        return __('events.state.' . $this->value);
    }

    /** @return list<string> */
    public static function values(): array
    {
        return array_map(static fn (self $s) => $s->value, self::cases());
    }

    // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    // Story 3-17 — Public visibility helpers
    // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

    /**
     * Is the event completely hidden from public visitors?
     * DRAFT and FAILED events are never publicly addressable, regardless of
     * cancellation state. Cancelled-DRAFT is covered by DRAFT.
     */
    public function isPubliclyHidden(): bool
    {
        return in_array($this, [self::DRAFT, self::FAILED], strict: true);
    }

    /**
     * Which public page shell should render?
     *
     * S3-4-F3 — This is a two-level dispatch: shellFor() selects the public page
     * mode (landing/cancelled/suspended), then the Blade second-level dispatch
     * selects the viewer sub-shell via registrantViewerMode().
     *
     * @param bool $cancelled Whether cancelled_at is set on the event row
     */
    public function publicShell(bool $cancelled): string
    {
        if ($cancelled) {
            return 'cancelled';
        }

        return match ($this) {
            self::SUSPENDED => 'suspended',
            default => 'landing',
        };
    }

    /**
     * Which viewer sub-shell should render when a registrant is authenticated?
     * Returns null for states where registrant viewer access is not applicable.
     *
     * @return ?string 'registered' | 'live' | 'ended' | null
     */
    public function registrantViewerMode(): ?string
    {
        return match ($this) {
            self::PUBLISHED,
            self::PREPARING,
            self::READY => 'registered',
            self::LIVE => 'live',
            self::ENDED => 'ended',
            default => null,
        };
    }

    /**
     * Is this event eligible for public indexing (sitemap, registrant access links)?
     *
     * @param bool $cancelled Whether cancelled_at is set on the event row
     */
    public function isPubliclyIndexable(bool $cancelled): bool
    {
        if ($cancelled) {
            return false;
        }

        return in_array($this, [
            self::PUBLISHED,
            self::PREPARING,
            self::READY,
            self::LIVE,
            self::ENDED,
        ], strict: true);
    }
}

    /**

    protected function setUp(): void

        if (RolePermission::count() === 0) {
            $this->seed(\Database\Seeders\Testing\TestPermissionSeeder::class);
        }
    }

    /**
     * Create the platform's is_system_team team for tests that exercise the
     * grantSystemAdmin / revokeSystemAdmin service paths.
     *
     * The production system team is seeded by SuperadminSeeder; in tests with
     * RefreshDatabase it must be created explicitly before calling the grant
     * service method.
     */
    protected function createSystemTeam(): Team
    {
        $owner = User::factory()->create(['email_verified_at' => now()]);

        /** @var Team $team */
        $team = Team::factory()->create([
            'user_id'         => $owner->id,
            'is_system_team'  => true,
            'personal_team'   => false,
        ]);

        return $team;
    }

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace Tests\Feature\Events;

use App\Enums\PlanTier;
use App\Enums\UserRole;
use App\Models\Team;
use App\Models\User;
use App\Modules\Events\Enums\EventState;
use App\Modules\Events\Models\Event;
use App\Modules\Events\Models\Registration;
use App\Modules\Events\Support\EventAuditEvents;
use App\Scopes\TeamScope;
use PHPUnit\Framework\Attributes\Group;
use PHPUnit\Framework\Attributes\Test;
use Spatie\Activitylog\Models\Activity;
use Tests\Feature\Billing\Support\BillingTestFixtures;
use Tests\Feature\FeatureTestCase;

/**
 * Capsule T6 — platform-admin revert of a PUBLISHED event back to DRAFT.
 *
 * ATDD: every test here is intentionally RED until the revert action exists.
 */
#[Group('events')]
class AdminRevertToDraftTest extends FeatureTestCase
{
    use BillingTestFixtures;

    #[Test]
    public function platform_admin_reverts_a_published_event_without_registrations_to_draft(): void
    {
        [$organiser] = $this->adminWithPlan(PlanTier::GROWTH);
        $superAdmin = $this->platformSuperAdminFor($organiser->currentTeam);
        $event = $this->eventFor($organiser, EventState::PUBLISHED);

        $this->actingAs($superAdmin)
            ->post(route('admin.events.revert-to-draft', $event->uuid), ['reason' => 'Published by mistake'])
            ->assertRedirect();

        $this->assertSame(EventState::DRAFT, $this->persisted($event)->state);

        // AC2 — the move must land through the guarded transition path, which is
        // observable as its audit record for the published -> draft edge.
        $transition = Activity::query()
            ->where('log_name', EventAuditEvents::EVENT_TRANSITIONED)
            ->where('subject_id', $event->id)
            ->latest('id')
            ->first();

        $this->assertNotNull($transition, 'Expected a guarded transition audit record for the revert.');
        $this->assertSame($superAdmin->id, (int) $transition->causer_id);
        $this->assertSame(EventState::PUBLISHED->value, data_get($transition->properties, 'from'));
        $this->assertSame(EventState::DRAFT->value, data_get($transition->properties, 'to'));
    }

    #[Test]
    public function workspace_admin_without_the_platform_capability_is_refused(): void
    {
        [$organiser] = $this->adminWithPlan(PlanTier::GROWTH);
        $event = $this->eventFor($organiser, EventState::PUBLISHED);

        $this->actingAs($organiser)
            ->post(route('admin.events.revert-to-draft', $event->uuid), ['reason' => 'Let me undo this'])
            ->assertForbidden();

        $this->assertNotReverted($event, EventState::PUBLISHED);
    }

    #[Test]
    public function revert_is_refused_when_the_event_is_not_published(): void
    {
        [$organiser] = $this->adminWithPlan(PlanTier::GROWTH);
        $superAdmin = $this->platformSuperAdminFor($organiser->currentTeam);
        $event = $this->eventFor($organiser, EventState::PREPARING);

        $this->actingAs($superAdmin)
            ->post(route('admin.events.revert-to-draft', $event->uuid), ['reason' => 'Support request']);

        $this->assertNotReverted($event, EventState::PREPARING);
    }

    #[Test]
    public function revert_is_refused_when_the_event_already_has_registrations(): void
    {
        [$organiser] = $this->adminWithPlan(PlanTier::GROWTH);
        $superAdmin = $this->platformSuperAdminFor($organiser->currentTeam);
        $event = $this->eventFor($organiser, EventState::PUBLISHED);
        $this->registerAttendee($event);

        $this->actingAs($superAdmin)
            ->post(route('admin.events.revert-to-draft', $event->uuid), ['reason' => 'Support request']);

        $this->assertNotReverted($event, EventState::PUBLISHED);
    }

    #[Test]
    public function cancelled_event_cannot_be_reverted(): void
    {
        [$organiser] = $this->adminWithPlan(PlanTier::GROWTH);
        $superAdmin = $this->platformSuperAdminFor($organiser->currentTeam);
        $event = $this->eventFor($organiser, EventState::PUBLISHED);
        $event->forceFill([
            'cancelled_at' => now(),
            'cancelled_by' => $organiser->id,
            'cancel_reason' => 'Speaker emergency',
        ])->save();

        $this->actingAs($superAdmin)
            ->post(route('admin.events.revert-to-draft', $event->uuid), ['reason' => 'Support request']);

        $fresh = $this->persisted($event);
        $this->assertSame(EventState::PUBLISHED, $fresh->state);
        $this->assertNotNull($fresh->cancelled_at);
        $this->assertNotReverted($event, EventState::PUBLISHED);
    }

    #[Test]
    public function only_the_published_to_draft_edge_is_added_to_the_canonical_table(): void
    {
        $expectedEdges = [
            EventState::DRAFT->value => ['published', 'suspended', 'failed'],
            EventState::PUBLISHED->value => ['preparing', 'suspended', 'failed', 'draft'],
            EventState::PREPARING->value => ['ready', 'failed', 'suspended'],
            EventState::READY->value => ['live', 'failed', 'suspended'],
            EventState::LIVE->value => ['ended', 'failed', 'suspended', 'ready'],
            EventState::ENDED->value => ['failed', 'suspended'],
            EventState::FAILED->value => ['preparing', 'suspended'],
            EventState::SUSPENDED->value => [],
        ];

        foreach (EventState::cases() as $state) {
            $actual = array_map(static fn (EventState $s) => $s->value, $state->transitionsTo());
            sort($actual);
            $expected = $expectedEdges[$state->value];
            sort($expected);

            $this->assertSame($expected, $actual, "Legal edges changed for {$state->value}.");
        }

        // State-derived rules other code reads from the table keep their answers.
        foreach (EventState::cases() as $state) {
            $this->assertSame(
                $state !== EventState::DRAFT,
                $state->isMetadataLocked(),
                "Metadata lock changed for {$state->value}.",
            );
            $this->assertSame(
                in_array($state, [EventState::DRAFT, EventState::ENDED, EventState::FAILED, EventState::SUSPENDED], true),
                $state->blocksRegistration(),
                "Registration blocking changed for {$state->value}.",
            );
            $this->assertSame(
                ! in_array($state, [EventState::DRAFT, EventState::FAILED, EventState::SUSPENDED], true),
                $state->isPubliclyIndexable(cancelled: false),
                "Public indexability changed for {$state->value}.",
            );
            $this->assertSame(
                $state !== EventState::SUSPENDED,
                $state->canBeSuspendedFrom(),
                "Suspend reachability changed for {$state->value}.",
            );
        }
    }

    private function assertNotReverted(Event $event, EventState $expected): void
    {
        $this->assertSame($expected, $this->persisted($event)->state);

        $this->assertFalse(
            Activity::query()
                ->where('log_name', EventAuditEvents::EVENT_TRANSITIONED)
                ->where('subject_id', $event->id)
                ->where('properties->to', EventState::DRAFT->value)
                ->exists(),
            'A refused revert must not record a transition to draft.',
        );
    }

    private function persisted(Event $event): Event
    {
        return Event::query()
            ->withoutGlobalScope(TeamScope::class)
            ->findOrFail($event->id);
    }

    private function eventFor(User $organiser, EventState $state): Event
    {
        return Event::factory()
            ->inState($state)
            ->for($organiser->currentTeam)
            ->create(['created_by' => $organiser->id]);
    }

    private function registerAttendee(Event $event): void
    {
        $email = 'registrant-'.$event->id.'@example.test';

        (new Registration)->forceFill([
            'team_id' => $event->team_id,
            'event_id' => $event->id,
            'email' => $email,
            'email_hash' => hash('sha256', $email),
            'full_name' => 'Early Registrant',
            'consent_accepted_at' => now(),
            'consent_ip' => '203.0.113.10',
        ])->save();
    }

    private function platformSuperAdminFor(Team $workspace): User
    {
        /** @var User $user */
        $user = User::factory()->create([
            'email_verified_at' => now(),
            'current_team_id' => $workspace->id,
        ]);

        $workspace->users()->attach($user, ['role' => UserRole::SYSTEM_ADMIN->value]);

        /** @var User $fresh */
        $fresh = $user->fresh(['currentTeam']);

        return $fresh;
    }
}

#[Group('events')]
class AdminRevertToDraftTest extends FeatureTestCase
{
    use BillingTestFixtures;

    #[Test]
    public function platform_admin_reverts_a_published_event_without_registrations_to_draft(): void
    {
        [$organiser] = $this->adminWithPlan(PlanTier::GROWTH);
        $superAdmin = $this->platformSuperAdminFor($organiser->currentTeam);
        $event = $this->eventFor($organiser, EventState::PUBLISHED);

        $this->actingAs($superAdmin)
            ->post(route('admin.events.revert-to-draft', $event->uuid), ['reason' => 'Published by mistake'])
            ->assertRedirect();

        $this->assertSame(EventState::DRAFT, $this->persisted($event)->state);

        // AC2 — the move must land through the guarded transition path, which is
        // observable as its audit record for the published -> draft edge.
        $transition = Activity::query()
            ->where('log_name', EventAuditEvents::EVENT_TRANSITIONED)
            ->where('subject_id', $event->id)
            ->latest('id')
            ->first();

        $this->assertNotNull($transition, 'Expected a guarded transition audit record for the revert.');
        $this->assertSame($superAdmin->id, (int) $transition->causer_id);
        $this->assertSame(EventState::PUBLISHED->value, data_get($transition->properties, 'from'));
        $this->assertSame(EventState::DRAFT->value, data_get($transition->properties, 'to'));
    }

    #[Test]
    public function workspace_admin_without_the_platform_capability_is_refused(): void
    {
        [$organiser] = $this->adminWithPlan(PlanTier::GROWTH);
        $event = $this->eventFor($organiser, EventState::PUBLISHED);

        $this->actingAs($organiser)
            ->post(route('admin.events.revert-to-draft', $event->uuid), ['reason' => 'Let me undo this'])
            ->assertForbidden();

        $this->assertNotReverted($event, EventState::PUBLISHED);
    }

    #[Test]
    public function revert_is_refused_when_the_event_is_not_published(): void
    {
        [$organiser] = $this->adminWithPlan(PlanTier::GROWTH);
        $superAdmin = $this->platformSuperAdminFor($organiser->currentTeam);
        $event = $this->eventFor($organiser, EventState::PREPARING);

        $this->actingAs($superAdmin)
            ->post(route('admin.events.revert-to-draft', $event->uuid), ['reason' => 'Support request']);

        $this->assertNotReverted($event, EventState::PREPARING);
    }

    #[Test]
    public function revert_is_refused_when_the_event_already_has_registrations(): void
    {
        [$organiser] = $this->adminWithPlan(PlanTier::GROWTH);
        $superAdmin = $this->platformSuperAdminFor($organiser->currentTeam);
        $event = $this->eventFor($organiser, EventState::PUBLISHED);
        $this->registerAttendee($event);

        $this->actingAs($superAdmin)
            ->post(route('admin.events.revert-to-draft', $event->uuid), ['reason' => 'Support request']);

        $this->assertNotReverted($event, EventState::PUBLISHED);
    }

    #[Test]
    public function cancelled_event_cannot_be_reverted(): void
    {
        [$organiser] = $this->adminWithPlan(PlanTier::GROWTH);
        $superAdmin = $this->platformSuperAdminFor($organiser->currentTeam);
        $event = $this->eventFor($organiser, EventState::PUBLISHED);
        $event->forceFill([
            'cancelled_at' => now(),
            'cancelled_by' => $organiser->id,
            'cancel_reason' => 'Speaker emergency',
        ])->save();

        $this->actingAs($superAdmin)
            ->post(route('admin.events.revert-to-draft', $event->uuid), ['reason' => 'Support request']);

        $fresh = $this->persisted($event);
        $this->assertSame(EventState::PUBLISHED, $fresh->state);
        $this->assertNotNull($fresh->cancelled_at);
        $this->assertNotReverted($event, EventState::PUBLISHED);
    }

    #[Test]
    public function only_the_published_to_draft_edge_is_added_to_the_canonical_table(): void
    {
        $expectedEdges = [
            EventState::DRAFT->value => ['published', 'suspended', 'failed'],
            EventState::PUBLISHED->value => ['preparing', 'suspended', 'failed', 'draft'],
            EventState::PREPARING->value => ['ready', 'failed', 'suspended'],
            EventState::READY->value => ['live', 'failed', 'suspended'],
            EventState::LIVE->value => ['ended', 'failed', 'suspended', 'ready'],
            EventState::ENDED->value => ['failed', 'suspended'],
            EventState::FAILED->value => ['preparing', 'suspended'],
            EventState::SUSPENDED->value => [],
        ];

        foreach (EventState::cases() as $state) {
            $actual = array_map(static fn (EventState $s) => $s->value, $state->transitionsTo());
            sort($actual);
            $expected = $expectedEdges[$state->value];
            sort($expected);

            $this->assertSame($expected, $actual, "Legal edges changed for {$state->value}.");
        }

        // State-derived rules other code reads from the table keep their answers.
        foreach (EventState::cases() as $state) {
            $this->assertSame(
                $state !== EventState::DRAFT,
                $state->isMetadataLocked(),
                "Metadata lock changed for {$state->value}.",
            );
            $this->assertSame(
                in_array($state, [EventState::DRAFT, EventState::ENDED, EventState::FAILED, EventState::SUSPENDED], true),
                $state->blocksRegistration(),
                "Registration blocking changed for {$state->value}.",
            );
            $this->assertSame(
                ! in_array($state, [EventState::DRAFT, EventState::FAILED, EventState::SUSPENDED], true),
                $state->isPubliclyIndexable(cancelled: false),
                "Public indexability changed for {$state->value}.",
            );
            $this->assertSame(
                $state !== EventState::SUSPENDED,
                $state->canBeSuspendedFrom(),
                "Suspend reachability changed for {$state->value}.",
            );
        }
    }

    private function assertNotReverted(Event $event, EventState $expected): void
    {
        $this->assertSame($expected, $this->persisted($event)->state);

        $this->assertFalse(
            Activity::query()
                ->where('log_name', EventAuditEvents::EVENT_TRANSITIONED)
                ->where('subject_id', $event->id)
                ->where('properties->to', EventState::DRAFT->value)
                ->exists(),
            'A refused revert must not record a transition to draft.',
        );
    }

    private function persisted(Event $event): Event
    {
        return Event::query()
            ->withoutGlobalScope(TeamScope::class)
            ->findOrFail($event->id);
    }

    private function eventFor(User $organiser, EventState $state): Event
    {
        return Event::factory()
            ->inState($state)
            ->for($organiser->currentTeam)
            ->create(['created_by' => $organiser->id]);
    }

    private function registerAttendee(Event $event): void
    {
        $email = 'registrant-'.$event->id.'@example.test';

        (new Registration)->forceFill([
            'team_id' => $event->team_id,
            'event_id' => $event->id,
            'email' => $email,
            'email_hash' => hash('sha256', $email),
            'full_name' => 'Early Registrant',
            'consent_accepted_at' => now(),
            'consent_ip' => '203.0.113.10',
        ])->save();
    }

    private function platformSuperAdminFor(Team $workspace): User
    {
        /** @var User $user */
        $user = User::factory()->create([
            'email_verified_at' => now(),
            'current_team_id' => $workspace->id,
        ]);

        $workspace->users()->attach($user, ['role' => UserRole::SYSTEM_ADMIN->value]);

        /** @var User $fresh */
        $fresh = $user->fresh(['currentTeam']);

        return $fresh;
    }
}
